metadata.description: zOne Playground: Claude Code plugins for zOne work. Plan and build features against the real code, review and test them with Playwright, handle your Azure DevOps bugs, tasks and PRs, and fill in your zOffice time sheet. Describe what you need, and the tools read the code, do the work and show you the evidence.

plugins.name: zone-test
plugins.description: zOne QA and Playwright E2E testing: review a feature's code with a team of tester agents and fix the bugs found by severity (/zone-test:qa); design, write and run a Playwright suite for a feature (/zone-test:feature); run an existing suite, fix test defects and rerun (/zone-test:e2e). Every run ends in a PDF report.

plugins.name: zoffice
plugins.description: zOffice time sheets: draft the day's entries from your Claude Code sessions with start, break and work-from-home options, let you edit them, and give you the command that posts them to Daily Activities with Playwright (/zoffice:log); clear today's entries (/zoffice:clear).

plugins.name: zwork
plugins.description: Azure DevOps work for zOne: a status dashboard and your bugs, tasks and PRs by state (/zwork:status, new, active, resolved); explain work items or review PRs against the code (/zwork:review); plan and fix bugs and tasks on their own branches (/zwork:plan); open linked PRs (/zwork:pr); check the connection (/zwork:init).

plugins.name: zdev
plugins.description: zOne feature development: plan a feature with you against the real code on Opus (read-only investigation, impact analysis, open questions, a reviewed plan) and build it on Sonnet or Opus after you approve (/zdev:plan); stop the frontend, build the backend and copy the module DLLs into it in one command (/zdev:copydll).
